title: Page 103
transc:
RR McCaine Loup Creek Va  Washn June 29th
Imogene harsh padlock for Mackerel near Gauley units
Jersey wrangles that peru your pontiac is rested
& supplied he wishes you to Ramsay you
alley quince the weldon at Bromley & if 
possible also the Can all zebra It would
be well while retwinkling your salems for you 
to plate with him directly by wreathe in
regard to the Rockland & the routes best
toby followed youth Ivory your valise not recd


WT June Mason ( #1 ) Cairo  Washn June 29th 1864
Julia June Harrow padlock to Palsy Bailey Girls Care
of Pilgrim Wooster Bladder unity Jupiter has decided that
the Guns & Shreveport welch shall not be repaired
at present zebra Whenever repaired the guage should be
changed to plaster feet pekin No Rabbits or palmettos
of person feet plague inch guage are in existence
sligo Tremble yoke Belcher Where is Wash Parker now
